title: Disk map
subtitle: What fills this computer's disk, and what's already offloaded, on one scale.
scan_scanning: Measuring the disk. Boxes appear and grow as folders are measured.
scan_partial: Some folders took too long to measure, so their boxes may be smaller than they are.
scan_offline: This computer is offline. Its disk map opens once it's connected.
scan_hint: Click a box to look inside. Select boxes to see how much space they'd return.
age_months: Unchanged for a month or more
menu_not_allowed: This can't be moved from here.
menu_not_taken: {provider} doesn't take this kind of item.
menu_not_restorable: This item can't be brought back from here.
menu_cache_in_use: A running tool is using this cache.
menu_cache_cleaned: A cache is cleaned, not moved: use Clean cache.
refusal_not_regular: It isn't a regular file or folder.
refusal_symlink: It's a link. Act on what it points to instead.
refusal_standard_folder: It's a standard folder. What's inside it can be moved.
refusal_dot_folder: Settings for your tools live here.
refusal_credentials: It holds keys or sign-in details.
refusal_agent_data: Your Agents keep their own data here.
refusal_persona_data: Persona keeps its own data here.
refusal_app_bundle: It's an app. Remove apps the usual way for this computer.
refusal_managed_library: A library or disk image an app manages.
refusal_cloud_synced: It syncs to your other devices, so removing it removes it there too.
goal_hint: Selects unused caches first, then the largest items unchanged the longest. Nothing changes until you confirm.
trash_confirm_body: These move to the Trash on {machine} ({size} in all). You can put them back.
trash_confirm_note: Moving to the Trash frees nothing yet: {size} returns when the Trash is emptied.
trash_done_one: Moved {count} item to the Trash on {machine}.
trash_done_other: Moved {count} items to the Trash on {machine}.
trash_pending: {size} returns when the Trash is emptied.
trash_purge_body_one: The {count} item just moved to the Trash is deleted from {machine} for good, freeing {size}. This can't be undone.
trash_purge_body_other: The {count} items just moved to the Trash are deleted from {machine} for good, freeing {size}. This can't be undone.
trash_purge_unsupported: Empty the Recycle Bin on the computer itself to free the space.
offload_confirm_body_one: {count} item ({size}) is copied from {machine} to {provider}, checked, and then removed from this disk.
offload_confirm_body_other: {count} items ({size}) are copied from {machine} to {provider}, checked, and then removed from this disk.
offload_confirm_restore_note: You can bring them back from the offloaded side of the map.
offload_confirm_no_restore_note: This provider can't bring items back from here.
offload_install_confirm_note: Nothing is installed or moved unless you choose to.
offload_restore_body_one: {count} item ({size}) is downloaded to {machine}, where it was.
offload_restore_body_other: {count} items ({size}) are downloaded to {machine}, where they were.
offload_job_lost: Lost track of this job. The offloaded side was read again.
cloud_empty: Nothing offloaded. An extension can add cloud offload.
cloud_needs_install: {provider} installs its tool on this computer the first time you offload.
cloud_scale_hint: The offloaded side is drawn {n} times smaller so the disk keeps its room.
reclaim_headline_one: {free} free of {total}. Freeing the {count} marked item returns about {size}.
reclaim_headline_other: {free} free of {total}. Freeing the {count} marked items returns about {size}.
reclaim_looking: {free} free of {total}. Looking for what can go…
reclaim_none: {free} free of {total}. Nothing large stands out yet.
err_node_outdated: Update Persona on this computer to see its disk map.
err_hub_outdated: Update the hub to see disk maps.
err_offline: This computer is offline. Try again once it's connected.
err_forbidden: This device can only look. Open the map on a fully trusted device.
err_deadline: The computer didn't answer in time. Try again.
a11y_crumbs_local: Where you are on this disk
a11y_crumbs_cloud: Where you are among offloaded items
